# Legends character assets (generated — do not edit)

Baked by `tools/legends/bake.mjs` from `tools/legends/legends.config.json` (format version 2, see
`tools/legends/FORMAT.md`). Regenerate from `games/nba2k-threejs/`:

```bash
cd tools/legends && npm install                 # optional dev dependency: meshoptimizer 0.22.0 (LODs)
node fetch.mjs legends.config.json              # CC0 MakeHuman / MPFB2 data, pinned to mpfbRef, verified by assets.lock.json
node bake.mjs legends.config.json               # → this folder
node measure.mjs ../../assets/legends/legends.json --likeness
```

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `legends.json` | header: bones, sections, shells, LODs, landmarks, masks, morph names, per-player data |
| `legends.shared.bin` | topology, UVs, wet-group vertex colours, skin weights, LOD indices, shared cloth/accessory/lash shells |
| `legends.<id>.bin` | per player: positions, normals, expression morph deltas, groom shells, shoe cover lists |
| `legends.skin0/1/2.png` | shared skin masks (lips/cavity/highlight; redness/AO/mottle; palms/nails) |
| `legends.<id>.groom.png`, `legends.<id>.extra.png` | per-player masks (scalp hair, beard, brows; tattoo, scalp gloss, sweat zones) |

## Licence and provenance

The body geometry, targets, rigs and skin weights come from the MakeHuman hm08 base mesh and the MPFB2 data
(<https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2>, commit `d0a32e57a7f915cb2f2b95410e2117648c7bbb7e`), released under
**CC0 1.0** (public domain dedication). MPFB's Python code (GPL) was not used or copied. Everything else — morph
calibration, grooming shells, masks, eyes, expression targets — is generated by this repository's own tools.
No photographs, textures, logos or third-party hair/clothing assets are included.
